# Chamsoudine Thienta — Official Portfolio

Chamsoudine Thienta, also known as Shams and Chamsoudine THIENTA, is a Software Engineer and Data Analyst based in Bamako, Mali. He is the founder of Shamsi Digital, displayed visually as SH☀MSI Digital.
